alert.headline: Gale Warning issued November 5 at 1:58AM CST until November 5 at 9:00PM CST by NWS Green Bay WI

alerts.headline: Gale Warning issued November 5 at 1:58AM CST until November 5 at 9:00PM CST by NWS Green Bay WI
alerts.description:
* WHAT...For the Gale Warning, north winds 15 to 25 kt with
gusts up to 30 kt and waves 2 to 5 ft expected. For the Small
Craft Advisory, north winds 15 to 25 kt with gusts up to 30 kt
and waves 3 to 6 ft expected.

* WHERE...Lake Michigan nearshore waters from Washington Island
to Sheboygan.

* WHEN...For the Gale Warning, from noon today to 9 PM CST this
evening. For the Small Craft Advisory, from 9 PM this evening
to 6 PM CST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds will cause hazardous waves which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.

upcoming.detailed_text: Southwest wind 10 to 15 knots with gusts to around 20 knots veering west late in the morning, then veering northwest 10 to 20 knots with gusts to around 25 knots early in the afternoon becoming north 15 to 25 knots with gusts to around 30 knots late in the afternoon. Areas of drizzle in the morning, then scattered showers in the afternoon. Waves 1 to 2 feet building to 3 to 5 feet late in the afternoon.
North wind 15 to 25 knots rising to up to 30 knots early in the morning. Slight chance of showers through around midnight. Waves 4 to 6 feet building to 5 to 7 feet in the late evening and overnight.
